dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Tom. I've just moved to Bangkok from England.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ˈtɑːm. aɪv dʒʌst ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk frəm ˈɪŋɡlənd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Welcome! I'm Nam. Bangkok is my hometown.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛlkəm! aɪm ˈnɑːm. ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So you've lived here for a long time.
dialogue.reading: soʊ juːv ˈlɪvd ˈhɪr fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, for twenty years. I grew up in a suburb, and my family still lives there.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, fər ˈtwɛnti ˈjɪrz. aɪ ˈɡruː ˈʌp ɪn ə ˈsʌbɜːrb, ənd maɪ ˈfæməli ˈstɪl ˈlɪvz ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's quiet, and the community is very friendly. My parents have lived in the same house since 2005.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈkwaɪət, ənd ðə kəˈmjuːnəti ɪz ˈvɛri ˈfrɛndli. maɪ ˈpɛrənts hæv ˈlɪvd ɪn ðə ˈseɪm ˈhaʊs sɪns ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈfaɪv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nice! I live downtown. I've been here since Monday, but I haven't slept well. It's so noisy!
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! aɪ ˈlɪv ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn. aɪv bɪn ˈhɪr sɪns ˈmʌndeɪ, bʌt aɪ ˈhævənt ˈslɛpt ˈwɛl. ɪts ˈsoʊ ˈnɔɪzi!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Downtown is always noisy. But the food there is great.
dialogue.reading: ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈnɔɪzi. bʌt ðə ˈfuːd ˈðɛr ɪz ˈɡreɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Can I visit your neighborhood someday?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈvɪzɪt jʊr ˈneɪbərhʊd ˈsʌmdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure! Let's go together one day.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr! ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ təˈɡɛðər ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.
